# pulse_user_identity (Resource)

Links a single sign-on identity to a dashboard user, so that the person can sign in with that provider: their next SSO sign-in whose ID token carries this subject (`sub` claim) signs in as this user. Use it for providers with `provisioning = "preprovisioned"`, where Pulse does not create or match users on its own.

An identity can be linked to one user only. Removing the link drops the roles the user got from SSO group mappings and ends their SSO sessions. Pulse refuses to unlink the last administrator who can sign in with SSO while password sign-in is disabled.

Import with `<user_id>/<provider_id>/<subject>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pulse_user" "alice" {
  email        = "alice@example.com"
  display_name = "Alice"
  roles        = ["administrator"]
}

# Alice signs in with the company identity provider; her subject (the "sub" claim) there is fixed.
resource "pulse_user_identity" "alice" {
  user_id     = pulse_user.alice.id
  provider_id = pulse_sso_provider.company.id
  subject     = "248289761001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) ID of the SSO provider (`pulse_sso_provider.<name>.id`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `subject` (String) The person's subject identifier at the provider: the `sub` claim of their ID token (at most 255 bytes). Many providers show it as the user's object or account ID. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user (`pulse_user.<name>.id`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<user_id>/<provider_id>/<subject>`.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer URL of the provider at the time the identity was linked.
- `linked_via` (String) How the identity was linked: `admin` (by an administrator, including this provider, or through an administrator's link invitation), `self_link` (the user linked it from their account page) or `jit` (created at the first SSO sign-in).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <user_id>/<provider_id>/<subject>
terraform import pulse_user_identity.alice 01j9z6q7m3c8k2v5x4w1n0p9r8/01j9z6t0b1d2e3f4g5h6j7k8m9/248289761001
```
